common_currency.why_one_unit: measured per-leg economics are linear in completion rate, so otherwise incomparable proposals become comparable -- and it is why almost everything resolves to the same lever

opportunities.title: Reprice a resting COMPLETE when L5's own touch moves
opportunities.why_that_classification: L5's touch moved and our clone did not follow it. Following L5's price is cloning him. Paying up to get filled would be a new strategy, and this proposal is explicitly not that: the new price is whatever the model says, never a tick more.
evidence: THE MECHANISM ALREADY EXISTS AND IS SWITCHED OFF FOR COMPLETE. The live session re-quotes when L5's touch moves, under `if relation_ in ("open", "extend") and touch != px_`. In the tape 36 OPEN and 35 EXTEND orders exited via repriced:touch_moved and 0 of 868 COMPLETEs did.
The crossing objection is already handled by an existing guard: `px >= opp_ask -> would_cross` runs ahead of the touch check for every relation.
404 accepted-but-unfilled COMPLETEs carry a rest book. In 164 (40.6%) L5's touch moved above where we sat, and in 96 of those the opposite ask reached that new touch.
27 of the 35 markets with an unfilled COMPLETE (77%) had at least one such moment.
Placement is not the defect: we price AT L5's touch in 70.3% of unfilled completes.
Distance, not patience, separates outcomes: filled completes sit a median 1 tick from the ask, unfilled 3 ticks (p75 8, max 48).
On L5's own history, 98.5% of his multi-fill completions happen at more than one price.
opportunities.expected_improvement: UPPER BOUND, not a forecast: 23.8% of unfilled completes had an L5-consistent reprice the book would have met. Conversion is unknown -- reaching a price is not filling it, and a re-quote loses queue position. At 3 points of completion this is +$0.20/dollar-hour and +$5.02/day; 1.10 points clears break-even. NOT AN EFFECT SIZE: EXTEND (which reprices) dies at the deadline 28.5% of the time against COMPLETE's 64.9%, but that gap is confounded by relation and must not be read as what the change would deliver.

bounded_test.change: add "complete" to the relation tuple on the existing touch_moved re-quote condition -- one condition on a code path that is already live and already proven on OPEN and EXTEND. Nothing new is built.
bounded_test.explicitly_not: no price the model did not return; no crossing; no widening of any cap
bounded_test.new_bound_required: a per-session cap on reprices, and the existing consecutive-rejection breaker must cover reprices too -- more orders on the #93 surface is the risk this carries, and #93 concentrates on COMPLETE. Repricing also surrenders queue position, which is a real cost the upper bound ignores: 2% of unfilled completes had the ask reach our price and still did not fill.
bounded_test.sample_before_reading: pre-register it the way the completion extension was: forward hours, sessions where it fired, settled venue-confirmed markets
bounded_test.what_would_make_it_fail: reprices become rejections (the #93 surface), or completion rises while pair profit per matched pair falls -- the capacity curve's half-profit sensitivity moves break-even from 84.5% to above 93%, so a cheaper fill that costs price is not a win
bounded_test.rollback: revert; it restores prior behaviour and costs nothing

opportunities.blocked_by: the COMPLETE extension is live under a frozen gate that needs 48 forward hours and 25 firings. Two changes to the same surface at once would make neither attributable. This waits for that verdict.

opportunities.title: Prefer markets with time left and two live sides
opportunities.why_that_classification: the model still decides what to do; this changes only which markets are put in front of it. That is selection, not behaviour -- but it is a real intervention and is not labelled a fidelity fix, because L5's own selection is not observable.
evidence: L5 pairs 93.3% of 15-minute windows against 65.7% of 5-minute ones.
Within a window, 82.9% when he opens with 80-100% of it left against 38.0% with under 20% left -- monotone across five buckets.
Balanced books (0.35-0.65) pair 74.6% on 5-minute windows and 97.7% on 15-minute ones; lopsided (<0.20 or >0.80) pair 49.7% and 33.3%.
opportunities.expected_improvement: RANGE, and transfer-limited: these magnitudes are measured on L5's crypto history and our lane trades sports. The mechanisms -- time to work a position, liquidity on the far side -- are not crypto-specific, but the sizes are not sports measurements. Direction is well supported; magnitude is not.

bounded_test.change: add time-to-settlement and book balance to the admission filter, shadow-only first
bounded_test.explicitly_not: no change to what the model decides once a market is admitted
bounded_test.new_bound_required: measure the candidate supply cost first: 50% of flat cycles already admit nothing, and a tighter filter that starves the lane trades a completion gain for an opportunity loss
bounded_test.sample_before_reading: run it as a shadow filter beside the live one and compare admitted sets before anything is enforced
bounded_test.what_would_make_it_fail: admitted-candidate count falls materially, or the sports transfer does not hold and completion is flat

opportunities.title: Close #93 for EXTEND and COMPLETE
opportunities.why_that_classification: a rejected order is not a behaviour, it is a failure to transmit one
evidence: 17.9% of COMPLETEs die by venue rejection, against 68.5% by no-fill.
OPEN is solved and the fix shipped: the authenticated book caught real mispricings live.

EXTEND (median +1 tick, 18 rows) and COMPLETE (median +2 ticks, 16 rows) rejections are NON-crossing on the venue's own book, and both still read NO_CONTROL_YET -- zero accepted controls in those stages.
opportunities.expected_improvement: NOT YET QUANTIFIABLE. Without accepted controls in those stages there is no comparison to make, and the honest answer is that the size of this is unknown rather than small.

bounded_test.change: none yet -- accumulate accepted EXTEND/COMPLETE controls until within_stage leaves NO_CONTROL_YET
bounded_test.explicitly_not: no pricing change on a hypothesis
bounded_test.sample_before_reading: enough accepted controls in each stage for a matched comparison

opportunities.title: More than one market at a time
opportunities.why_that_classification: premature rather than wrong. The slope through the current rung is negative, so scaling multiplies the loss; and the P&L arm is UNVERIFIABLE because on held cycles the selector never ran, so the universe a second slot would have drawn from was never recorded.
evidence: 41.9% of flat selection cycles admitted two or more markets, so SUPPLY would support a second slot -- but that is supply, not profit.
At 83.4% completion the lane runs at -$1.84/day. Two slots would run at roughly twice that.
Stranded residual already consumes 44% of capital-hours while being 25% of markets.
opportunities.expected_improvement: NEGATIVE at the current completion rate. Revisit once realized dollars per dollar-hour is positive, not before.

bounded_test.explicitly_not: do not scale a negative unit economic

opportunities.title: Add capital
opportunities.why_that_classification: the money is not what is scarce
evidence: Mean capital in use is $1.03 against a bankroll of about $111 -- under 1%.
The largest single position ever committed $19.31, 17% of it.
opportunities.expected_improvement: ZERO. More money buys nothing while concurrency is 1 and the slope is negative.

classification_key.NOT_AN_OPPORTUNITY_ON_THIS_EVIDENCE: kept in the list with its reason attached, because a missing option looks like an oversight

the_line_that_must_not_be_crossed: 'Reprice to where L5 moved' is fidelity. 'Pay another cent to get filled' is a new strategy. They are one tick apart in code and a world apart in kind, and no proposal here may drift from the first into the second.
every_number_is_a_bound: the evidence supports 'this many opportunities existed', never 'this many would have converted'. Each entry says which it is.
read_only: Nothing here is deployed. No cap, gate, threshold, band or concurrency setting moves without the owner's explicit go, and the frozen COMPLETE experiment is untouched.
